shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin dipped below $78,000, triggering over $264 million in crypto liquidations.
Strong US jobs data pushed Fed rate hike odds to nearly 60%, with August CPI/PPI data awaited.
Escalating US-Iran tensions caused oil prices to rise, reigniting inflation concerns.
Ethereum's supply on exchanges reached a multi-year low, signaling strong institutional demand.
Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains at "Greed" (71) despite Bitcoin's price pullback.
